title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms.
reason: Foundational work on Transformer architecture — must understand its design choices and limitations for any research on attention mechanisms.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
reason: Key reference for pre-training methodology — our approach builds on BERT's masked language modeling paradigm.
